title: The Chemistry of Tobacco Ash
body:
Tobacco ash is not just a grey mass. It retains metal oxides, carbonates, and trace amounts of organic compounds. Interestingly, the ash composition depends heavily on combustion temperature and tobacco variety.

I plan to dig into this in more detail later.

title: Physics in Engineering: Bridges
body: When you look at a bridge, you rarely think about load distribution. Yet every span is a compromise between strength, weight, and cost. The laws of statics, strength of materials, and a bit of thermodynamics are all at work here.

title: Where Sciences Meet: Physical Chemistry
body: Physical chemistry is where the equations of physics explain the behaviour of molecules. Reaction rates, activation energy, entropy — all of it lives on the border between two disciplines.
